absentComponent.en: The absent primary-filing component is the petition portion of “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” (official form ID ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT) for the Arkansas veterans treatment court route.
absentComponent.es: El componente ausente de presentación principal es la parte de la petición de “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” (identificador oficial ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT) para la ruta del tribunal de tratamiento para veteranos de Arkansas.

specificReason.en: The current official PDF is not included in this packet, and the ACIC uniform petition-and-order pair governs this component. These instructions therefore do not supply a custom petition in its place.
specificReason.es: El PDF oficial vigente no está incluido en este paquete, y el par uniforme de petición y orden de ACIC rige este componente. Por eso, estas instrucciones no proporcionan una petición personalizada para sustituirlo.

destination.name: Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC) / Arkansas Department of Public Safety
destination.en: The official destination for the missing “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” is the Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC), within the Arkansas Department of Public Safety; use its criminal-history forms index.
destination.es: El destino oficial para obtener “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair”, que está ausente, es el Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC), dentro del Arkansas Department of Public Safety; use su índice de formularios de antecedentes penales.

nextAction.en: Open the ACIC criminal-history forms index and obtain the current official petition portion identified as ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT before continuing this filing.
nextAction.es: Abra el índice de formularios de antecedentes penales de ACIC y obtenga la parte vigente de la petición oficial identificada como ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT antes de continuar con esta presentación.

en: The current official petition portion of “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” from the ACIC forms index.
The corresponding current official order portion named in the same ACIC pair so the two components remain matched.
es: La parte vigente de la petición oficial de “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” obtenida del índice de formularios de ACIC.
La parte correspondiente de la orden oficial vigente nombrada en el mismo par de ACIC, para mantener emparejados ambos componentes.

en: Do not create, retype, or file a custom petition as a replacement for the ACIC petition.
Do not assume that any document already in this packet is the missing official petition.
es: No cree, transcriba ni presente una petición personalizada para sustituir la petición de ACIC.
No suponga que algún documento ya incluido en este paquete sea la petición oficial ausente.

packetAbsenceDisclosure.en: This packet does not include the primary filing component “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” (ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT); you must obtain the current official component from ACIC.
packetAbsenceDisclosure.es: Este paquete no incluye el componente de presentación principal “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” (ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT); usted debe obtener de ACIC el componente oficial vigente.

en: Your answers already saved for the Arkansas veterans treatment court route must remain in your Briefcase.
Any documents already saved for this route must remain attached to the same Briefcase item while “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” is outstanding.
es: Sus respuestas ya guardadas para la ruta del tribunal de tratamiento para veteranos de Arkansas deben permanecer en su Briefcase.
Todo documento ya guardado para esta ruta debe permanecer adjunto al mismo elemento de Briefcase mientras esté pendiente “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair”.

en: Obtain the current official “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” identified by ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT.
Add that exact official component to the saved Arkansas veterans treatment court route before continuing.
es: Obtenga la versión oficial vigente de “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” identificada por ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT.
Agregue ese componente oficial exacto a la ruta del tribunal de tratamiento para veteranos de Arkansas guardada antes de continuar.

return.en: After you obtain the exact ACIC component, return to the saved Arkansas veterans treatment court route in your Briefcase, add it there, and continue from that same item.
return.es: Después de obtener el componente exacto de ACIC, regrese en su Briefcase a la ruta del tribunal de tratamiento para veteranos de Arkansas guardada, agréguelo allí y continúe desde ese mismo elemento.

payment.en: Checkout for the missing “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” component must remain unavailable, and you must not be charged for it.
payment.es: La opción de pago para el componente ausente “ACIC veterans treatment court petition and order pair” debe permanecer no disponible; no se le cobre ningún pago por este componente.

credit.en: No packet credit or partner packet credit may be consumed for the missing ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT component.
credit.es: No se puede consumir ningún crédito de paquete ni crédito de paquete del socio por el componente ausente ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT.

escalation.actor: Arkansas Crime Information Center (ACIC) / Arkansas Department of Public Safety
escalation.en: If the ACIC index does not provide the exact current petition identified as ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT, ask the Arkansas Crime Information Center / Department of Public Safety where to obtain that petition before proceeding.
escalation.es: Si el índice de ACIC no proporciona la petición vigente exacta identificada como ACIC-PETITION-VETERANS-COURT, pregunte al Arkansas Crime Information Center / Department of Public Safety dónde obtenerla antes de continuar.
